title: agent-history event envelope v1
description: One line of an NDJSON batch: a prompt, reply, tool call, tool result or bus message. Unknown properties are allowed so that an older reader accepts a newer producer.

event_id.description: Globally unique and stable across re-reads: a native id that is unique across sessions, a session-scoped native id prefixed with the session key (ScopedID), or 'sha256:' plus hex sha256(session_key NUL line NUL content).

ts.description: When it happened on the laptop, from the source. Never the time of reading.

agent.description: Open set: claude, codex, gemini, grok, feedguard, bus, ...

command.description: Set when the tool is a shell. Limit is in bytes.

content.description: Redacted text. Limit is in bytes (maxLength counts characters here; Validate counts bytes).

raw.description: The full redacted source record, at most 1 MiB serialized.

truncated.description: content or raw was cut to fit its cap.

model.description: The model that produced this event, as the tool reports it, lower-case. Set on events of an assistant turn; empty elsewhere and when the tool does not say. Never guessed.

effort.description: The thinking or reasoning level the tool reports for that turn, lower-case (low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ...). Same rules as model.

thinking.description: True when the assistant turn contained a thinking or reasoning block. Only ever sent as true: absent means not reported.

resume_cmd.description: How to reopen the session, set by the adapter.
